items.heading: Platform: one changelog gate
items.body: Harbor Grid ops locked staging and production to a shared promote checklist, so reviewers no longer compare mismatched cut notes.

items.heading: Forecast: three-site pilot is live
items.body: A fictional day-ahead board now shows confidence bands for North, Central, and South. The numbers exist only for this public demo.

items.heading: Ops: quiet on-call week
items.body: No Sev-1 in the sample narrative. Time went to documentation and a dry-run cutover instead of incident spend.

pages.title: Fictional decision: keep the single changelog gate.
pages.verdict: Keep one checklist before promote. Splitting notes by channel would reopen drift.
interpretations: One gate means reviewers read the same list before an alias moves.
The extra wait from split staging and production notes is gone.
pages.notes: Verdict first; the two metrics only defend keeping the gate.
